rationale: Three-lens review (blind, edge-case, acceptance, all full-capability) ran against the 11-file branch-vs-base diff (1109 insertions, 59 deletions), with plan.md as the acceptance spec and the project's git-workflow/code-quality/security guides as standards context. Two confirmed correctness bugs block approval: (CR-001) _spend()'s empty-subquery NULL semantics cause costless sessions to be wrongly counted as spend_sessions whenever no personal-billed session exists in the window, contradicting this diff's own documented invariant and the committed (but not demonstrably executed) live test for it; (CR-002) get_users' ORDER BY cost_usd DESC has no NULLS LAST, so costless developers now sort to the top of the spend leaderboard under Postgres's default NULL ordering. Additionally, the acceptance lens found no evidence anywhere in the diff/task artifacts that the mandatory, non-skippable make test-cli-analytics-live gate (or the OpenAPI baseline drift check) was actually executed and its output reported, despite extensive new live-Postgres test code being written -- this is exactly the scenario where CR-001 would have been caught had the suite run, so the missing evidence is itself load-bearing. Standards review passed (commit messages are EPMCDME-16496-prefixed; the reader.py module-size guideline exception is consistent with the guide's actual wording since this changes the module's own existing core responsibility; no new injection surface, all SQL remains parameterized/structural). 7 dismissed concerns (NULLS LAST already correctly applied to _TOP_MODEL, DISTINCT correctly keyed to s.session_id post-JOIN-widening, _DEVELOPER correlation correctly bound via the `s` alias at every call site including get_users_last_active, no duplicate EXISTS evaluation, UNION-not-UNION-ALL dedup is correct, session_usage confirmed to have day/session_id columns via migration, dropped self._scope(f) in get_cost_kpis is structurally equivalent via the sel join) are not emitted as findings.

findings.title: _spend()'s empty-subquery semantics let costless sessions count as spend_sessions
findings.problem: _spend(alias) returns `{alias}.session_id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM sel WHERE sql_personal_billed('sel'))`. Per standard SQL, `x NOT IN (<empty subquery>)` evaluates to TRUE even when x is NULL (IN over an empty set is unconditionally FALSE, bypassing normal NULL propagation). Before this diff _spend was only ever evaluated against a row guaranteed to exist (inner-joined cost_daily), so the alias was never NULL. This diff's get_cost_kpis rewrite (`FROM sel s LEFT JOIN cost_daily c`) and get_users rewrite (`RIGHT JOIN sel s`) newly expose NULL c.session_id for costless sessions to this same predicate used in `count(DISTINCT s.session_id) FILTER (WHERE _spend("c")) AS spend_sessions`. Whenever no session in the current window is personal-billed (the common case, including every seeded scenario in the new test_live_session_activity_window.py), the inner subquery is empty and _spend("c") is vacuously TRUE for every row, including costless ones.
findings.impact: Costless, company-billed sessions get wrongly counted into spend_sessions whenever the window contains zero personal-billed sessions, directly contradicting the invariant this same diff documents in cli-analytics-storage.md ("a costless company-billed session is wrongly counted as a spend session" -- stated as the failure mode to avoid). This also silently understates get_cost's avg_cost_per_session (inflated denominator). The committed live test test_a_costless_company_billed_session_does_not_count_as_a_spend_session exercises exactly this path and would fail against the current code, but there is no evidence (see CR not raised separately, folded into the test-evidence gap below) that make test-cli-analytics-live was actually run to catch it.
findings.recommendation: Guard _spend's NOT IN against the empty-subquery case, e.g. require the alias's own session_id be non-NULL before evaluating NOT IN (`{alias}.session_id IS NOT NULL AND {alias}.session_id NOT IN (...)`), or restructure as a correlated NOT EXISTS so three-valued NULL semantics apply normally regardless of whether any personal-billed session exists in the window.

findings.title: get_users' cost_usd DESC ordering has no NULLS LAST, so costless developers sort first
findings.problem: `ORDER BY cost_usd DESC, ({_DEVELOPER}) {_C}` has no NULLS LAST. The RIGHT JOIN sel s widening in this same diff intentionally admits costless developers with cost_usd = NULL. PostgreSQL's default null-ordering for DESC is NULLS FIRST, so every costless/zero-spend developer now sorts to the top of a query meant to be "sorted by spend" -- the same class of bug this diff's own _TOP_MODEL change (`DESC NULLS LAST`, a few lines above) was fixed for, but the fix was not applied here.
findings.impact: Any caller/UI presenting get_users as a spend leaderboard will show zero-spend developers at the top instead of the bottom, a visible, user-facing ordering regression introduced by widening the universe to be costless-inclusive.
findings.recommendation: Add `NULLS LAST` to the cost_usd DESC ordering: `ORDER BY cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST, ({_DEVELOPER}) {_C}`.

findings.title: No evidence the mandatory make test-cli-analytics-live gate (or OpenAPI baseline check) was actually run
findings.problem: The project's own plan.md and quality-gates.md mark `make test-cli-analytics-live` as mandatory and non-skippable for any change under src/codemie/repository/cli_analytics/postgres/, and Task 5 requires `make ruff && make test-cli-analytics-live && make test` to all pass with real, non-skipped output reported in the MR description's Test harness section, plus an OpenAPI baseline drift check. Nothing in the diff's 11 changed files -- including the task's own events.jsonl (two generic plan-artifact lifecycle events only) -- or an MR description shows any of these commands were actually executed and their output captured. Substantial new live-Postgres test code was written (test_live_session_activity_window.py and others) but writing tests is not the same as running them.
findings.impact: Without a demonstrated real run, there is no evidence CR-001 (which the project's own new live test test_a_costless_company_billed_session_does_not_count_as_a_spend_session would have caught) or any other regression was actually detected before this reached review; the gate existing specifically to prevent that is exactly what appears to have been skipped.
findings.recommendation: Run `make ruff && make test-cli-analytics-live && make test` for real, capture the non-skipped make test-cli-analytics-live output, include it in the MR description's Test harness section, and perform/record the OpenAPI baseline drift check before this is considered done.
